description: Use when the traveler wants to browse or compare Bloomy eSIM plans for one destination themselves. Lists plans cheapest first, single-country plans before regional ones, each with data (GB), validity (days), plan_type, networks (4G/5G), top-up support, price_jpy, price_usd, price_as_of and plan_id. Filter by trip length, minimum GB and plan type. For a recommendation with reasons, recommend_plan is the better fit.

destination.description: Required. Country name (English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish or French) or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "Japan", "日本" or "JP". A country with no dedicated plan returns an error, never plans for a different country.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

limit.description: Maximum number of plans to return, 1 to 20. Default 8.

min_days.description: Trip length in days (integer). Fixed-GB plans valid for fewer days are skipped; daily plans are priced for this many days.

min_gb.description: Minimum data in GB, e.g. 3. For fixed-GB plans this is the total; for daily plans it is the high-speed allowance per day.

plan_type.description: "data" = a fixed amount of GB for the whole validity period; "unlimited" = daily plans priced per day (a daily high-speed allowance, then slower speed). Omit to include both.
